Ollama 会在启动模型时自动尝试探测服务器中安装的显卡（Nvidia GPU: When starting a model, Ollama automatically detects the graphics card installed on the server (Nvidia GPU, etc.). If the CUDA driver matches, it will automatically use the GPU to accelerate the model's throughput rendering, making the response output dozens of times faster! If there is no graphics card, Ollama falls back to using the CPU for mathematical inference.
